title: Forty Tabs, One Cart

slices.alt: Comic, part 1 of 9: Verdict Picks Toon: Forty Tabs, One Cart
Comic, part 2 of 9: Caption: Black Friday, 6:02 a.m. Sam: Forty tabs. Every single one says DEAL.
Comic, part 3 of 9: Jo: Americans spent $7.1 billion online on Thanksgiving alone, says Adobe.
Comic, part 4 of 9: Sam: BILLION? With a B?

Comic, part 5 of 9: Board, What is actually selling (Nov 26-27, 2026): Consoles on Thanksgiving +1,058% (Adobe); NeeDoh toys at Walmart 80% sold by midday; Nintendo Switch 2 No. 1 console of 2026 (Circana) Sources: Adobe via USA Today; Walmart's merchandising chief via Fox Business; Circana via VGChartz.
Comic, part 6 of 9: Vera: Popular isn't the same as cheap. Vera: Check one thing before you click: the model number.

Comic, part 7 of 9: Caption: Some doorbuster TVs are store-only versions with their own model numbers. Compare the model number, not the box. Board, Buy today or wait for Cyber Monday?: TVs, toys, appliances Black Friday; Apparel, furniture Black Friday; Electronics, computers Cyber Monday Adobe's 2026 forecast of the best day for each category (Sept 28, 2026).
Comic, part 8 of 9: Jo: Our rule: it's a deal only at or under its past low.
Comic, part 9 of 9: Sam: One cart. Three things. Zero regret. What is actually selling, and the price that makes each deal real: the list is below.
